name: Carboneras de Guadazaón (Spain)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Carboneras de Guadazaón (a monstrance, a ladder, mountains and a river on red).
history: Municipal flag of Carboneras de Guadazaón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Carboneras de Guadazaón arms — monstrance, ladder, mountains and river
